about.title: About Opmet Osserpse
lines: Opmet Osserpse is a creative studio based in Venice, California.
We bring together world-class creators to make incredible work with our partners.
We are designers, musicians, filmmakers, writers, developers, artists.
Our work starts by hand, with pencils, paper and physical tools.
Our music and sound studio is called espresso tempo.
